purpose: Curated machine-readable catalogue of real upstream agent repositories used as implementation references. Not project status, memory, or runtime authority.

references.name: OpenAI Codex
references.adopt: Separation of model-authored messages from runtime/tool/approval/completion state.
references.avoid: Do not copy the complete runtime when only a lifecycle or execution-boundary pattern is needed.

references.name: Cline
references.adopt: Centralized provider/model result semantics, including empty-response versus tool-only-turn behavior.
references.avoid: Do not create a second provider subsystem when the target already has one canonical owner.

references.name: Hermes Agent
references.adopt: One agent core across channels and progressive loading of memory, skills, and integrations.
references.avoid: Do not import subagent authority into a target architecture that deliberately uses one reasoning agent.

references.name: OpenHands
references.adopt: Explicit action/observation and lifecycle-state patterns for software-engineering runtimes.
references.avoid: Do not add a parallel planner/controller when the target's canonical turn already owns reasoning.

references.name: Aider
references.adopt: Repository mapping and selective context expansion before edits.
references.avoid: Do not equate repository awareness with file authority or load the whole repository into context.

references.name: LobeHub
references.adopt: Separate provider/model metadata, configuration, capability, readiness, and integration lifecycle.
references.avoid: Do not treat configured state as runtime readiness.

references.name: OpenClaw
references.adopt: Keep session/agent identity independent from CLI, UI, browser, or messaging transports.
references.avoid: Do not let channel clients become separate reasoning authorities.

references.name: Agent Zero
references.adopt: Use as a comparative implementation reference for extensibility and local-agent patterns.
references.avoid: Do not treat it as a default target architecture without checking ownership and lifecycle fit.

references.name: Gemini CLI
references.adopt: Use for Gemini-native tool and CLI behavior when provider-specific evidence is required.
references.avoid: Do not infer provider-neutral contracts from Gemini-specific behavior alone.
